raw:
Based on the race reports I retrieved, the answer is most likely **Takuma Sato**, though I could not fully confirm that he was in the car for every round.

- Fisichella drove for Jordan in 2002. Sato appears as a Jordan finisher in the Malaysian (round 2), Brazilian (round 3), Canadian (round 8), German (round 12), Hungarian (round 13) and Japanese (round 17) Grands Prix, and he is the only other Jordan driver in those reports.
- Ralph Firman, who I'd expect to be the other Jordan driver early in the year, never appears in any of the results I retrieved, so I couldn't check his races.
- Sato's absence from the Australian top 10 doesn't rule him out, since he may have finished outside it.

So Sato is the teammate across the rounds I could verify, but the searches didn't cover every round, so this isn't a full season-by-season check.

ANSWER: Takuma Sato
